scene: You step off the propeller trolley onto Paper Plane Airport's busy rooftop.
picture: Flat side-view along a level rooftop. At far left rests a giant paper glider. Next sits the idling propeller trolley. The player stands beside it wearing an orange puffer vest, white scarf, and kite. In the centre, a brass robot folds origami. On the right rises a wooden tower with an open door.
shown: a giant folded paper glider resting on a launcher at far left
a brass folding robot creasing parchment sheets in the centre
a spiralling wooden control tower with an open door on the right

variants.scene: The breeze tugs your scarf as the propeller trolley doors slide shut behind you.
Fresh evening air rustles discarded parchment across the wide launch platform.
Looking out across the glowing rooftop, you wonder if you will find {quest} here.
